# netgear_vlan (Data Source)

One VLAN as the switch has it configured, read from `show running-config`.

Reading a VLAN the switch does not define is an error. Use `netgear_vlans` to discover which ids exist.

~> VLAN 1 is built into FASTPATH and is not printed in the running config, so it cannot be read here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netgear_vlan" "mgmt" {
  vlan_id = 10
}

output "mgmt_uplinks" {
  value = data.netgear_vlan.mgmt.tagged_ports
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vlan_id` (Number) The 802.1Q VLAN id to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The VLAN id as a string.
- `name` (String) VLAN name, empty when the switch has none for it.
- `routing` (Boolean) Whether `vlan routing` is enabled for this VLAN.
- `tagged_ports` (Set of String) Ports carrying this VLAN tagged, in FASTPATH notation such as `0/1`.
- `untagged_ports` (Set of String) Ports participating in this VLAN untagged.
